security_audit.summary: The audit confirms the critical remote installer recommendation at SKILL.md:14, where a script is downloaded over HTTPS and piped directly into sh. The remaining confirmed issues are intended external CLI examples that contact inference.sh or install related skills. No prompt injection attempt or hidden data-exfiltration instruction was found.

remediation.issue: Quick Start recommends piping a remote installer directly into sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace it with manual download steps, a pinned version, and checksum verification before execution.

remediation.issue: Generation examples rely on an external CLI and remote inference services.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before running infsh commands and explain that prompts or input images may be sent to an external service.

remediation.issue: Related-skills commands install additional skills through npx.
remediation.suggestion: Use marketplace links or require users to review each related skill before installation.

content.value_statement: Store screenshots must meet strict platform rules and explain value fast. This skill guides screenshot specs, gallery order, captions, mockups, videos, and localization.
actual_capabilities: Lists Apple App Store screenshot dimensions for iPhone and iPad targets.
Lists Google Play screenshot, feature graphic, and promo video requirements.
Recommends gallery ordering with priority on the first three screenshots.
Provides caption rules and benefit-focused caption examples.
Provides sample infsh commands for mockups, comparisons, and preview video scenes.
Includes localization, A/B testing, and submission checklist guidance.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI for the included generation examples.
Does not verify current Apple or Google policy changes automatically.
Does not inspect an app build or capture real screens automatically.
Generated assets still need manual brand and compliance review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first app listing
use_cases.description: Create a platform-specific screenshot plan with required sizes, order, captions, and asset checks.

use_cases.title: Refresh store conversion assets
use_cases.description: Improve the first three screenshots, test alternative captions, and plan Google Play experiments.

use_cases.title: Plan localized launch visuals
use_cases.description: Decide which markets need translated captions, new screenshots, or English default assets.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Store Screenshots
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new listing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the app-store-screenshots skill to plan a screenshot gallery for [app]. Target [iOS, Android, or both]. Include dimensions, order, and captions.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Screenshot Captions
prompt_templates.scenario: Caption rewrite for an existing asset set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these screenshot captions for store readability: [captions]. Rewrite each caption with a clear user benefit and a maximum of two lines.

prompt_templates.title: Create Mockup Prompts
prompt_templates.scenario: Image generation planning for multiple screenshot styles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create generation prompts for [app type] screenshots. Include hero, feature highlight, lifestyle context, and before-after variants for [platform].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Launch Assets
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before submission or testing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my store launch asset plan: [plan]. Check platform requirements, first three screenshots, localization, preview video, and testing risks.

output_examples.input: An indie developer needs iOS screenshots for a habit tracker.
output: A first screenshot focused on streak progress and the main benefit.
A second screenshot highlighting reminders or weekly planning.
A third screenshot showing progress insights or a trusted result.

output_examples.input: A marketer wants Google Play assets for a finance app.
output: A portrait screenshot set within the 320 to 3840 px limits.
A testing plan for caption and order variants.

output_examples.input: A product team needs preview video guidance.
output_examples.output: A 30 second structure with a hook, three feature moments, and an app icon end screen.

best_practices: Lead with the strongest user outcome in screenshot position one.
Keep captions benefit-focused, readable, and limited to two lines.
Verify current platform rules before final export or submission.
anti_patterns: Do not use settings or onboarding screens as primary screenshots.
Do not make every screenshot show the same composition or message.
Do not run installer or generation commands without reviewing external service risks.

faq.question: Does this cover both Apple and Google stores?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes iOS screenshot dimensions, Google Play screenshot rules, feature graphic guidance, and preview video notes.

faq.question: Can it create final image files by itself?
faq.answer: The skill provides generation commands and planning guidance. Actual image creation requires running the inference.sh CLI or another image tool.

faq.question: Will the listed dimensions always be current?
faq.answer: No. Verify current Apple and Google requirements before submission, especially after device or policy updates.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it help with localization?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains which markets may need translated captions, full screenshot sets, or English defaults.

faq.question: Is an external service required?
faq.answer: The included generation examples use inference.sh, so prompts and input images may be sent to that service.
